Welcome — and thanks for stopping by.

This blog is where I share practical notes on data science, economics, and
statistical modelling. My day-to-day work sits at the intersection of applied
analytics, machine learning, and decision-focused communication, and this site
gives me a place to turn that work into clear, reusable write-ups.

![Welcome post thumbnail](thumbnail.jpg)

You can expect a mix of:

- hands-on tutorials in R and Python
- project notes on modelling, forecasting, and experimentation
- lessons on making technical work useful for real decisions

I am starting with a small set of pages, then expanding the site with deeper
case studies and tutorials over time.
